import itertools
import random

def solve_small(n, iterations=2000000):
    matches = list(itertools.combinations(range(n), 2))
    num_matches = len(matches)
    min_cost = float('inf')
    for _ in range(iterations):
        p = list(range(num_matches))
        random.shuffle(p)
        first = [num_matches + 1] * n
        last = [-1] * n
        for day in range(num_matches):
            u, v = matches[p[day]]
            if day + 1 < first[u]: first[u] = day + 1
            if day + 1 > last[u]: last[u] = day + 1
            if day + 1 < first[v]: first[v] = day + 1
            if day + 1 > last[v]: last[v] = day + 1
        cost = sum(last[i] - first[i] + 1 for i in range(n))
        if cost < min_cost:
            min_cost = cost
    return min_cost

import itertools

def solve_small_exact(n):
    matches = list(itertools.combinations(range(n), 2))
    num_matches = len(matches)
    min_cost = float('inf')
    for p in itertools.permutations(range(num_matches)):
        match_order = [matches[i] for i in p]
        first = [num_matches + 1] * n
        last = [-1] * n
        for day in range(num_matches):
            u, v = match_order[day]
            first[u] = min(first[u], day + 1)
            last[u] = max(last[u], day + 1)
            first[v] = min(first[v], day + 1)
            last[v] = max(last[v], day + 1)
        cost = sum(last[i] - first[i] + 1 for i in range(n))
        min_cost = min(min_cost, cost)
    return min_cost
